nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Primary developer and AI agent instructions file for the OrdeloAgent project, documenting the architecture, delivery lifecycle, key packages, database access patterns, and coding conventions for Claude Code.

nodes.name: OrdeloDb.session.sql
nodes.summary: Ad-hoc SQL session file containing a quick query stub, likely used as a scratch pad for database exploration via a SQL IDE client session.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for the Ordelo AI Agent Chatbot, covering the system purpose, recommended service naming conventions, project directory structure, and instructions for running the application.

nodes.name: agents.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive internal technical reference documenting all agents, modules, WhatsApp handlers, data persistence patterns, configuration, environment setup, and a quick-search task map for the OrdeloAgent system.

nodes.name: aws_app_runner.sh
nodes.summary: Minimal shell wrapper that starts the application via AWS App Runner entrypoint, setting required environment variables before delegating to the main start script.

nodes.name: build_push_deploy_dimage.sh
nodes.summary: CI/CD helper script that builds the Docker image, pushes it to the container registry, and triggers a redeployment of the AWS App Runner service in a single command.

nodes.name: prestart.sh
nodes.summary: Pre-start hook executed before the main server process, used to apply any pending database migrations or environment initialisation steps.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project configuration using Hatchling as the build backend, declaring all runtime and dev dependencies, UV package manager settings, Ruff linting rules (F-only), basedpyright type-checking config, and pytest options.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses UV dependency groups for separating runtime vs dev deps; Hatchling wheel build targets src layout.

nodes.name: requirements-dev.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned development dependency list including testing tools (pytest, pytest-asyncio) and type stubs, used alongside the primary requirements.txt for local development environments.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned runtime dependency list covering FastAPI, LangGraph, pywa (WhatsApp Business API), Supabase client, psycopg, and AI/LLM dependencies for production deployment.

nodes.name: run_setup.sh
nodes.summary: Comprehensive local environment setup script that creates a Python virtual environment, installs dependencies via UV or pip, configures AWS credentials, and validates the environment is ready for development.

nodes.name: is_venv_functional
nodes.summary: Checks whether an existing Python virtual environment is usable by verifying its Python binary is executable.

nodes.name: setup_dev.sh
nodes.summary: Lightweight dev environment bootstrap that installs development-only dependencies and sets up local configuration files for contributors.

nodes.name: setup_notes.txt
nodes.summary: Extensive freeform notes covering deployment procedures, AWS configuration steps, Supabase setup, WhatsApp Business API registration, environment variable requirements, and troubleshooting tips accumulated during project development.

nodes.name: start.sh
nodes.summary: Production server startup script that launches the FastAPI application using Gunicorn with Uvicorn workers, configuring worker counts, timeouts, and bind address from environment variables.

nodes.name: upload_secrets.sh
nodes.summary: Utility script for uploading application secrets to AWS Secrets Manager, with logging helpers and validation checks before each upload operation.
